name: omnideck
description: Self-hosted control and observability platform for services, infrastructure, data sources, alerts, and automation

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @omnideck/server" "npm run dev -w @omnideck/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @omnideck/web && npm run build -w @omnideck/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @omnideck/server && npm run test -w @omnideck/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @omnideck/server && npm run typecheck -w @omnideck/web
